verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ חַלְּצֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה רָ֑ע מֵאָדָ֣ם תִּנְצְרֵֽנִי׃ מֵאִ֖ישׁ חֲמָסִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ ḥal·lə·ṣê·nî Yah·weh rā‘ mê·’ā·ḏām tin·ṣə·rê·nî mê·’îš ḥă·mā·sîm
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David Rescue me O LORD from evil men Protect me from men of violence

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָשְׁב֣וּ רָע֣וֹת בְּלֵ֑ב יָג֥וּרוּ מִלְחָמֽוֹת׃ כָּל־ י֝֗וֹם
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ḥā·šə·ḇū rā·‘ō·wṯ bə·lêḇ yā·ḡū·rū mil·ḥā·mō·wṯ kāl- yō·wm
verses.literal: who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long

verses.original: שָֽׁנֲנ֣וּ לְשׁוֹנָם֮ כְּֽמוֹ־ נָ֫חָ֥שׁ חֲמַ֥ת עַכְשׁ֑וּב תַּ֖חַת שְׂפָתֵ֣ימוֹ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: šā·nă·nū lə·šō·w·nām kə·mōw- nā·ḥāš ḥă·maṯ ‘aḵ·šūḇ ta·ḥaṯ śə·p̄ā·ṯê·mōw se·lāh
verses.literal: They sharpen their tongues like snakes the venom of vipers is on their lips Selah

verses.original: שָׁמְרֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֨ה׀ מִ֘ידֵ֤י רָשָׁ֗ע תִּנְצְרֵ֑נִי מֵאִ֣ישׁ חֲמָסִ֣ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָ֝שְׁב֗וּ לִדְח֥וֹת פְּעָמָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šā·mə·rê·nî Yah·weh mî·ḏê rā·šā‘ tin·ṣə·rê·nî mê·’îš ḥă·mā·sîm ’ă·šer ḥā·šə·ḇū liḏ·ḥō·wṯ pə·‘ā·māy
verses.literal: Guard me O LORD from the hands of the wicked Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble . . .

verses.original: גֵאִ֨ים׀ טָֽמְנֽוּ־ פַּ֡ח לִ֗י וַחֲבָלִ֗ים רֶ֭שֶׁת פָּ֣רְשׂוּ לְיַד־ מַעְגָּ֑ל מֹקְשִׁ֖ים שָֽׁתוּ־ לִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ḡê·’îm ṭā·mə·nū- paḥ lî wa·ḥă·ḇā·lîm re·šeṯ pā·rə·śū lə·yaḏ- ma‘·gāl mō·qə·šîm šā·ṯū- lî se·lāh
verses.literal: The proud hide a snare for me the cords of their net are spread along the path and lures are set out for me Selah

verses.original: אָמַ֣רְתִּי לַ֭יהוָה אָ֑תָּה אֵ֣לִי הַאֲזִ֥ינָה יְ֝הוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
verses.literal: I say to the LORD You are my God Hear O LORD . . . my cry for help

verses.original: יְהֹוִ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי עֹ֣ז יְשׁוּעָתִ֑י סַכֹּ֥תָה לְ֝רֹאשִׁ֗י בְּי֣וֹם נָֽשֶׁק׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ă·ḏō·nāy ‘ōz yə·šū·‘ā·ṯî sak·kō·ṯāh lə·rō·šî bə·yō·wm nā·šeq
verses.literal: O GOD the Lord the strength of my salvation You shield my head in the day of battle

verses.original: תִּתֵּ֣ן אַל־ יְ֭הוָה מַאֲוַיֵּ֣י רָשָׁ֑ע אַל־ תָּ֝פֵ֗ק זְמָמ֥וֹ יָר֥וּמוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: tit·tên ’al- Yah·weh ma·’ă·way·yê rā·šā‘ ’al- tā·p̄êq zə·mā·mōw yā·rū·mū se·lāh
verses.literal: Grant not O LORD the desires of the wicked do not promote their evil plans [lest] they be exalted Selah
May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused

verses.original: גֶּֽחָ֫לִ֥ים יָמִיטוּ עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם יַפִּלֵ֑ם בָּאֵ֥שׁ בְּ֝מַהֲמֹר֗וֹת בַּֽל־ יָקֽוּמוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ge·ḥā·lîm yå̄·mī·ṭū ‘ă·lê·hem yap·pi·lêm bā·’êš bə·ma·hă·mō·rō·wṯ bal- yā·qū·mū
verses.literal: May burning coals fall on them may they be thrown into the fire into the miry pits never to rise again

verses.original: אִ֥ישׁ לָשׁוֹן֮ בַּל־ יִכּ֪וֹן בָּ֫אָ֥רֶץ רָ֑ע יְ֝צוּדֶ֗נּוּ לְמַדְחֵפֹֽת׃ אִישׁ־ חָמָ֥ס
verses.transliteration: ’îš lā·šō·wn bal- yik·kō·wn bā·’ā·reṣ rā‘ yə·ṣū·ḏen·nū lə·maḏ·ḥê·p̄ōṯ ’îš- ḥā·mās
verses.literal: May no slanderer . . . . . . be established in the land may calamity hunt down . . . the man of violence

verses.original: יָדַעְתִּ כִּֽי־ יְ֭הוָה יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה דִּ֣ין עָנִ֑י מִ֝שְׁפַּ֗ט אֶבְיֹנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: yå̄·ḏaʿ·ti kî- Yah·weh ya·‘ă·śeh dîn ‘ā·nî miš·paṭ ’eḇ·yō·nîm
verses.literal: I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor [and defends] the cause of the needy

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ צַ֭דִּיקִים יוֹד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶ֑ךָ יְ֝שָׁרִ֗ים אֶת־ יֵשְׁב֥וּ פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ṣad·dî·qîm yō·w·ḏū liš·me·ḵā yə·šā·rîm ’eṯ- yê·šə·ḇū pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Surely the righteous will praise Your name the upright . . . will dwell in Your presence
